quest.title: Down in the Dumps
quest.description: You fall into a mysterious sewer. Now, you have to find a way to get back up as quickly as possible...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: ...I detect an energy reaction in the vicinity...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Um... W—Where are we??? {NICKNAME}, are you alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't believe that scary giant bird attacked us just like that, with zero warning! Do you think that scary giant thing is that "Zala" Nastya was talking about...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Nastya lied to us!? Aw, come on! Paimon was really looking forward to this!

choices.text: Maybe Nastya didn't lie to us...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Wait, wait... Are you saying Zala's only like this to us? Then maybe it's because... y'know... we don't have branches sticking out of our heads like Nastya?

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: But to that monster whose sole objective is to preserve the status quo here, our approaching is a form of danger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But why, though...? We're only here to get Goggles' body part back, that's all...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Oh! Paimon gets it now! It's all because of Goggles' power! That's what's making this town feel so warm and weird!

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: That half-man, half-bird creature named Zala... and the way the local residents have transformed in both body and mind... All of these feel extremely familiar to me.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: I can remember now... one of the four who created my body back then at some secret location... He was a leading figure of Snezhnaya's now-vanished school of bio-alchemy...

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: All these we are seeing are very much aligned with his approach to "life."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... So the thing we're looking for is with this Koshchei person?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sheesh... This town feels even weirder now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So anyway... first we take Nastya home, then we look for Koshchei or whatever his name is, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's... gonna keep us busy for a while.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We should find a way to get back to the ground first.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, there's no way we'll find anything just hanging around here... Come on! Let's get out of this dump, fast!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then we'll ask Nastya when we find her!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we didn't do anything wrong! If anything, we're the good guys here! We're helping Nastya get home, for crying out loud!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh heh! Paimon to the rescue~

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We're counting on you here, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how did the people who built this even get around here? Did they have wings too or something???

talks.objective: Find a way to get out of the sewer and back to the surface
Investigate the control room in the sewer

dialogues.speaker: Control Guide (I)
dialogues.text: ...must undergo three rounds of authentications... <color=#00E1FFFF>Keys made of gold, silver, and iron</color>... placed in three different locations... inserted into the respective recesses...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Found it! Looks like there's a name written on the cover of this tattered little book... "Doctor Moreau"? Uh, so these are the notes written by that kind doctor?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whatever. So all we have to do is go to these three spots and find the <color=#00E1FFFF>gold, silver, and iron keys</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Then we insert them into the three places, and... and we should be able to get out, right?
